chunks: Ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from al-Qāsim ibn al-Walīd, who said:
I asked him about the ghusl (ritual bath) of al-Aḍḥā. He said: “It is obligatory except at Minā.”

key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Minā, the sacred location associated with hajj rites
key_terms.ٱلْأَضْحَى: Eid al-Aḍḥā, the festival of sacrifice

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the ghusl of Eid al-Aḍḥā, and is there an exception for those in Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the ghusl (ritual bath) for Eid al-Aḍḥā. It states that the ghusl is obligatory, with an exception for one who is at Minā.
